answer_2.quote: Automatic Metrics Aligning with previous work for evaluating summarization systems , we use F1 scores of Rouge-1 (R1), Rouge-2 (R2), Rouge-L (RL), and Rouge-Lsum (RLsum) , BERTScore , METEOR , sacreBLEU and NIST ) for model's performance evaluation.

answer_3.quote: Inspired by , we engage GPT-4 to assess our candidate models using the same guidelines as our human evaluators.

answer_4.quote: we randomly select 10 instances from the BookSum dataset and conduct a human evaluation. The evaluators we have recruited are graduate and doctoral candidates with specializations in Computer Science or Computational Linguistics... Evaluators should rate the candidate summaries on a scale of 1 to 5 for relevance (R), informativeness (I), conciseness (C), and faithfulness (F)... They also need to give an overall ranking of the five summaries.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators rate summaries on a 1-5 scale for relevance, informativeness, conciseness, and faithfulness, and provide an overall ranking.
